title: Advanced Scientific Domains - Exhaustive Mathematical Coverage
brief: Cover every remaining mathematical, statistical, and scientific domain applicable to CNC machining. Stochastic processes, information theory, optimal control, and more.

units.title: StochasticProcessEngine - Markov/Wiener/Poisson models for machining
units.description: Model machining processes as stochastic systems: (1) Markov chain for tool state transitions (sharp->worn->chipped->broken with transition probabilities from data), (2) Wiener process for continuous wear modeling (VB(t) = VB_0 + mu*t + sigma*W(t)), (3) Poisson process for random tool breakage events (lambda = breakage rate), (4) Hidden Markov Model for unobservable states (subsurface damage detection from surface vibration). Each model outputs: state probabilities, expected remaining life, optimal decision policy.

units.title: InformationTheoryEngine - Entropy-based process monitoring
units.description: Apply information theory to machining: (1) Shannon entropy of force signal for process stability assessment (low entropy = stable, high = chaotic), (2) mutual information between sensor channels for redundancy analysis, (3) Kullback-Leibler divergence for detecting process drift (current distribution vs reference), (4) transfer entropy for causal analysis (does vibration cause force changes or vice versa?), (5) sample entropy (SampEn) for time-series complexity. Complements MEGM (which minimizes thermodynamic entropy).

units.title: OptimalControlEngine - Pontryagin/Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman for toolpaths
units.description: Apply optimal control theory: (1) Pontryagin minimum principle for time-optimal toolpath (minimize cutting time subject to force/temp constraints), (2) Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman for stochastic optimal control (handle uncertainty in material properties), (3) Model Predictive Control (MPC) for receding-horizon feed/speed optimization (look ahead N segments, optimize, execute 1, repeat), (4) Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) for vibration suppression. State: [position, feed, force, temp]. Control: [feed_override, rpm_override].

units.title: GraphTheoryEngine - Network models for manufacturing
units.description: Apply graph theory: (1) directed acyclic graph (DAG) for operation precedence constraints (which ops must precede which), (2) minimum spanning tree for tool path linking (minimize non-cutting moves), (3) traveling salesman for hole pattern optimization (shortest drilling sequence), (4) max-flow/min-cut for chip evacuation channel design, (5) graph coloring for fixture/setup optimization (conflict-free setups). Uses adjacency matrix representation, Dijkstra/A* for pathfinding.

units.title: FuzzyNeuralHybridEngine - Neuro-fuzzy parameter optimization
units.description: Combine fuzzy logic with neural networks for parameter optimization in uncertain conditions. Implements: (1) ANFIS (Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System) for speed/feed recommendation from imprecise inputs ('somewhat hard material', 'long overhang'), (2) fuzzy Taguchi for robust parameter design under noise, (3) Type-2 fuzzy sets for handling uncertainty about uncertainty (membership function uncertainty), (4) fuzzy AHP for multi-criteria tool selection. Complements PARETO (crisp multi-objective) with fuzzy multi-objective.
